segments.t: Back in their dorm room, Bu Xiaogu shocks her friend Qin Xiao by giving up her sought-after television station internship to join Xingtian Entertainment, where star producer Chun Yuqiao works. Listen to their debate first.
我放弃电视台，去星天娱乐。
布小谷，你是不是疯了？
那里多少人挤破头都进不去！
我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。
我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
制作公司。
你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？
干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
我决定了，我要去见他，跟他学习！
Let's unpack their argument. Xiaogu drops her big announcement in one crisp sentence.
我放弃电视台，去星天娱乐。
'I am giving up the television network and going to Xingtian Entertainment.' Chinese chains two actions in time order without needing a word for 'and': first "fangqi", 'give up', then "qu", 'go to'.
布小谷，你是不是疯了？
'Bu Xiaogu, have you gone crazy?' Using "shi bu shi", literally 'is or isn't', frames a pointed yes-or-no challenge when the speaker already suspects the answer, and "feng le" means 'gone mad'.
那里多少人挤破头都进不去！

'So many people fight tooth and nail and still cannot get in there!' Vivid "ji po tou" literally pictures squeezing until heads break, while "jin bu qu" inserts "bu" inside 'go in' to mean 'cannot get in'.
我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。
'If I go there as an intern, I can join the Twelve Singers crew.' Notice "jiu" plus "neng", literally 'then can', which marks the second half as the direct payoff of going there as an intern.
我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
'Let me ask you a question: where is the core business of show production?' Casual speech often drops "yi", 'one', in "wen ni ge wenti", literally 'ask you a question'.
制作公司。
'Production companies.' Notice the word order in "zhizuo gongsi": "zhizuo", 'production', sits directly in front of "gongsi", 'company', just like English.
你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？
'Dare you say you are not giving up a golden job in hand because of him?' Chinese calls a secure, prestigious career a "jin fanwan", literally a 'golden rice bowl' that will always keep you fed.
干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？

'Working in our line of work, who would not want to learn from him?' Here "hang" (pronounced second tone, not "xing") means profession or trade, and inclusive "zanmen" pulls the listener into 'our' shared field.
我决定了，我要去见他，跟他学习！

'I have decided — I am going to meet him and learn from him!' Short, emphatic "wo jueding le" seals a choice, and "gen ta xuexi" literally says 'study with him' for 'learn from him'. Now let's listen to their dorm-room debate once more.
我放弃电视台，去星天娱乐。
布小谷，你是不是疯了？
那里多少人挤破头都进不去！
我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。
我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
制作公司。
你敢说你不是为了他，放弃到手的金饭碗？
干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
我决定了，我要去见他，跟他学习！
Xiaogu has made up her mind to trade safety for Xingtian Entertainment. You heard how to say "wo jueding le", challenge someone with "shi bu shi", and talk about a "jin fanwan".
明天见！
